about: A cross-section of layers stacked top to bottom, each band as thick as it really is, coming forward as it is named with its name and a note beside it, and a probe that can sink through them: the Earth's layers, soil and rock, the atmosphere, skin, the layers of a system.

layers.about: the layers from top to bottom, split by |

sizes.about: each layer's thickness, split by commas; equal when left out

notes.about: a note for each layer, such as its depth, split by |

probe.about: 1 sinks a marker through the layers as each is named

when.about: moments each layer comes forward; else when its name is said, or one after another
